migration_flags.description: Field qty_done on stock.move.line does not exist in Odoo 19. Use 'quantity' instead.

Field product_uom_qty (reserved quantity) on stock.move.line does not exist in Odoo 19. The reserved quantity is now unified with done quantity as 'quantity'. The stored computed 'quantity_product_uom' gives the value in product base UoM.

stock.move no longer has group_id (Many2one procurement.group). It now has reference_ids (Many2many stock.reference). stock.move.line only has a derived Char 'reference' field, never a direct relational group link.
New field package_history_id (Many2one stock.package.history) tracks package movement snapshot. Not present before Odoo 16.
New Boolean field 'picked' (stored computed, writable) tracks whether the line has been physically picked. Not present before Odoo 16.

key_findings.quantity_field: Single 'quantity' field replaces both qty_done and product_uom_qty (reserved) from Odoo 15; quantity_product_uom is stored computed in base UoM
key_findings.lot_auto_creation: _action_done resolves lot_name to lot_id by searching existing lots; creates new stock.lot via _create_and_assign_production_lot when use_create_lots=True and lot not found
key_findings.package_src_dest: package_id=source package at location_id; result_package_id=destination package at location_dest_id; result_package_id drives putaway and quant attribution
key_findings.action_done_flow: 1-validate rounding+lot, 2-resolve lot_name to lot_id, 3-batch create new lots, 4-delete zero-qty lines, 5-create package history, 6-move quants (unreserve+deduct src+credit dest), 7-apply pkg dest, 8-stamp date=now()
key_findings.date_field: Set at creation; auto-updated on picked transition and on quantity increase when picked; stamped to now() after all quants moved in _action_done
key_findings.aggregation: _get_aggregated_product_quantities groups by product+name+description+uom+packaging_uom (ignores lots); accumulates backorder ordered quantities; returns qty_ordered from move.product_uom_qty
key_findings.owner_id: Partner owning the inventory; passed to all quant reservation and availability operations; supports 3PL ownership scenarios
key_findings.state: Related (stored) from move_id.state - no independent state on the line
key_findings.reference: Move line has only Char 'reference' related to move_id.reference; reference_ids Many2many stock.reference is on stock.move only
